main_text.p: Rursus Petrucius vel hypotheticus in linea collaterali descendente habet
main_text.l: patrui magni, vel amitinæ magnæ, avunculi magni, & materteræ magnę
main_text.p: Personæ porrò his Petrucii vel hypothetici consanguineis junctæ, affinitatem constituunt, de quibus horum præcipuè generum & nominum usus est.
Vitricus est maritus matris, ex alio viro natis, stiefvatter.
Noverca, est patris uxor, ex alia matre natis, stiefmutter.
Privignus, filius uxoris, ex alio viro, vel mariti ex alia uxore filius, stieffsohn [?].
Privigna, uxoris ex alio viro, vel mariti ex alia uxore filia, stieftochter [?].

page.notes: Diagram braces are rendered as diagram lines with levels: labels at level 1, the entries under each brace at level 2. The German terms at the end of the page are in black letter; the long s is normalised to s. "stieffsohn" and "stieftochter" are uncertain readings from the scan and are marked [?]. A small circle mark beside the line "filiam, neptim" is not text and is omitted. The left edge shows part of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.
